line.s1_intro.text: After the snack the room is a mess. Apples and pears lie mixed up on the rug.

line.s1_sq_mixed.text: Everything is mixed up! How do we tidy it?

line.s1_deer_idea.text: Apples in one basket, pears in the other. Everything goes to its group.

line.s1_apples.text: Tap all the apples. Each one flies to the apple basket.

line.s1_not_apple.text: That is not an apple. We are looking for apples.

line.s1_apples_done.text: All the apples are together. This is the group of apples.

line.s1_not_pear.text: That is not a pear. We are looking for pears.

line.s1_pears_done.text: And this is the group of pears. Tidy!

line.s1_deer_happy.text: Now you can see at once what is where!

line.s1_daily.text: We group at home too: spoons with spoons, socks with socks, blocks with blocks.

line.s2_sq_size.text: Can we sort them another way? Big with big and small with small!

line.s2_big.text: The same fruit, a different rule. Tap all the big ones.

line.s2_not_big.text: That one is small. We are looking for big ones.

line.s2_not_small.text: That one is big. We are looking for small ones.

line.s2_summary.text: The same things can be grouped in different ways. First we say the rule, then we sort.

line.p_intro.text: Now you sort. Listen to what we are looking for and tap.

line.a_intro.text: Grouping is tidying. Try it at home.

line.a_sq_socks.text: After the laundry sort the socks: dark with dark, light with light.

line.a_deer_toys.text: And the toys? Cars with cars, blocks with blocks!

card.a_parents:
For the parent:
When tidying toys, say the rule out loud: "all the cars into the box".
Then change the rule: "everything red". The same things, different groups.
